description: Grid Blocks - 60 NM (CAES) (DPIRD-056) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. This spatial boundary supports the Catch and Effort System (CAES) Blocks – 60 Nautical Mile (NM) Grid, in relation to the recording of fisheries catch data against a spatial grid of Western Australian waters for research and reporting purposes. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Primary Industries and Regional Development. Its tags are boundaries, fisheries, grid, nautical mile grid. It offers 9 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geojson, geopackage, gpx. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
